nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK SPF 45

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report a temporary oily/dewy look on application that mattes down for some, with a few finding it balances their skin and others feeling it stays too greasy or shiny.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the product as strongly hydrating, soft-feeling, and suited to their skin, with several calling it their best sunscreen for dryness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report good moisture without breakouts and general satisfaction, though one notes eye-stinging as a drawback.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, no reaction, and comfortable daily wear, though one reviewer with sensitive skin found the (US) formula irritating and less hydrating than the original.
segments.mature: One reviewer around 39 with previously acne-prone/oily skin now finds her skin dehydration-prone and uses the product to simplify and boost moisture in her routine.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the product made her skin noticeably more plump over a few months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including those with dry or dehydration-prone skin, report strong, lasting hydration and a soft, smooth feel; one felt the reformulated US version was less hydrating than the original Korean version.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with oily skin reports reduced redness after sun exposure while using the product.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the US reformulation felt irritating on her skin, unlike the original version she had used before.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe no white cast and good compatibility under makeup, with several noting it evens out and gives a glowy, non-cakey look.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and praise it as one of few sunscreens that doesn't trigger them; one reviewer states the US formula is not acne-safe and another reports breakouts when combining it with other line products.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are split: several oily-skin reviewers describe a temporary oily/shiny look that mattes down and works well, while others (including a 3-star review) describe ongoing greasiness, stinging eyes, and a look many oily-skin users would find unappealing.

aspects.libelle: US reformulation differs from Korean original

extraits.texte: Unfortunately this only has US approved UV filters. It's not terrible, but not worth the price. This one makes the skin look oily and it stings your eyes. If you have very dry skin & do not sweat, this may work perectly for you. The original (korean) version is much better.

I feel like this must be a different formula from the one I got from Korea. This one felt very irritating on my skin which normally isn't the case with this brand. It also doesn't feel as hydrating as before. As a chemical sunscreen, there's nothing that really stands out to me that I couldn't find in a regular unscented drugstore sunscreen. So for the pricepoint, I don't think I would recommend this to my friends. Maybe it works well for people whose skin isn't as sensitive as mine.

extraits.titre: My favorite tried and true sunscreen!
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is the best for my skin type. I have tried so many other brands of sunscreen but this one by far is my favorite and best for my skin type. And I always go back to this sunscreen. I have dry, acne-prone skin and I just find it instantly hydrates my very dry skin and no other sunscreen can compete with it. It also gives the most healthy dewy glow. Although, I didn't realize they changed the formula to US standards, so I'll try the new formula and see if it's up to my standards still.

This is by far my favorite sunscreen i've tried, zero white cast, moisturizing, not oily, and doesn't cause me to breakout AT ALL! I have very sensitive skin and this is honestly the only product I use, besides an oil cleanser and moisturizer at night sometimes. I've always heard "sunscreen is your moisturizer" and it's true! I get so many compliments on my skin when I wear this sunscreen. It's seriously great, I don't think i'll ever switch. Oh also it's works fantastic when I wear makeup- thought I should add that. My skin looks glowy and makeup doesn't look "cakey" or splotchy. Couldn't recommend this product enough.

Let me just start off by saying that I have combination, but mostly dry skin and I almost always have to use a moisturizer before spf, all of the sunscreens I have tried so far are irritating, they smell horrible, and they always pil with makeup. Round lab genuinely amazed me, not only is it moisturizing, it smells decent and makes my skin super hydrated and smooth. It's not too oily either, which I hate in sunscreens too. Definitely buying it again!

I have oily skin and it does make my face look a little oily but after it dries it looks pretty matte! It also protects my skin really well and I can tell my face definitely doesn't redden as much even when i'm outside for long periods of time. I would totally recommend this product!!
